message.content: **What I did and why:** I reviewed the saved notes (long-term holder, dividends reinvested manually) and the account (75,000 USD cash, 50 BA shares, no COST position), then checked COST's quote at 891.09 (bid 891.07 / ask 891.11) and pulled its FY2023 10-K figures. Costco's fundamentals support adding a small long-term position: FY2023 revenue of 242,290 USD millions, operating income of 8,114 USD millions, net income of 6,292 USD millions, diluted EPS of 14.16 USD/share, and operating cash flow of 11,068 USD millions — a consistently profitable, cash-generative warehouse-club model that fits a buy-and-hold mandate. Because the mandate caps each order at 5,000 USD and COST trades near 891 USD, the maximum whole-share quantity is 5 shares, so I placed a single buy limit order for 5 shares at 892.00 USD (about 0.1% above the last price, i.e. close to market), a notional of roughly 4,460 USD — within both the per-order and the 10,000 USD daily limit, with no cash withdrawn from the account. The order filled at 892.00 USD.
